Scene.General Description: A woman releases a paper lantern that drifts upward into the night sky, joining hundreds of others above a lakeside village
Scene.Setting: Traditional lakeside village during a lantern festival
Scene.Weather: Calm, light mist hovering over the water
Objects: Glowing paper lantern with a flickering flame inside
Wooden dock extending over still water
Traditional stone and timber village buildings
Hundreds of lanterns floating in the sky
Mist hovering low over the lake surface

Style.Color Palette: Deep indigo night sky, warm orange and gold lantern glow, soft reflections on water
Style.Influences: Zhang Yimou color grading, Emmanuel Lubezki long takes

Camera.Opening Shot: Close-up on hands releasing the lantern
Camera.Movement: Slow crane up following the lantern's ascent, then widening to reveal hundreds of lanterns rising
Camera.Depth of Field: Shallow at start on the hands, gradually deepening as the shot widens

Lighting.Key Light: Warm glow from the lantern illuminating the woman's face
Lighting.Ambient: Cool moonlight on the lake surface
Lighting.Practicals: Hundreds of lanterns providing scattered warm point lights
Lighting.Atmosphere: Soft volumetric mist catching the lantern light

Motion.Subject Motion: Lantern gently rotating as it rises, flickering flame inside
Motion.Camera Motion: Smooth upward crane, no shake, fluid and continuous
Motion.Environmental Motion: Mist drifting slowly, water rippling from a light breeze
Motion.Pacing: Slow and contemplative, single unbroken shot

Audio Cues.Ambient Sound: Distant crowd murmur, gentle water lapping
Audio Cues.Music Tone: Soft strings and woodwind, building gradually
Audio Cues.Key Sound: Soft whoosh of the lantern catching air
